rule: A patient reply may name a source only when status is approved and audience is public, and only when the patient's own words match a topic. Candidates and clinician-only entries are a shelf and are never cited. Notes are not page text.

sources.name: NICD
sources.note: The NICD homepage is a public and clinician starting point for communicable-disease information, and this entry does not cite a separate disease A to Z page.

sources.name: Cochrane
sources.note: The Cochrane homepage is the public and professional entry to its systematic reviews, and this entry does not cite the Cochrane Library host.

sources.name: MedlinePlus
sources.note: MedlinePlus is a US patient health-topic library and is not a South African dosing source; where it differs from a South African page, follow the National Department of Health.

sources.name: NHS Conditions
sources.note: The NHS conditions index is a UK public page, not South African protocol; where it differs from a South African page, follow the National Department of Health.

sources.name: CDC
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: The CDC homepage was not opened in this run, so it is not approved; it is a US page and not an authority for South African HIV, TB, medicines, or immunisation, and where it differs follow the National Department of Health.

sources.name: NDoH Knowledge Hub e-Library
sources.note: The Knowledge Hub e-library is a National Department of Health shelf for clinicians and is never named in a patient reply.

sources.name: STG and Essential Medicines List
sources.note: This National Department of Health page points at standard treatment guidelines and the essential medicines list, and it is clinician context only.

sources.name: National Consolidated HIV Guidelines 2026
sources.note: The 2026 national consolidated HIV guidelines file was not opened in this run, so it stays a clinician candidate and is not cited.

sources.name: SAMRC
sources.note: The SAMRC homepage is research-council context only and is not a patient-education source.

sources.name: NICE guidance
sources.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.note: The NICE guidance index is UK clinician guidance, not a South African standard; where it differs from a South African page, follow the National Department of Health.
